example: "El campo es muy apacible hoy" (The countryside is very peaceful today)
"El niño estaba muy inquieto antes del examen" (The boy was very restless before the exam)
"Siento una gran melancolía al ver las fotos antiguas" (I feel a great melancholy when looking at the old photos)
"Mi vida cotidiana es muy activa" (My daily life is very active)
"No te apresures, tenemos tiempo" (Don't rush, we have time)
"El sol de la tarde está deslumbrante hoy" (The afternoon sun is dazzling today)
"El hotel está en un lugar muy remoto" (The hotel is in a very remote place)
